Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، إِلٰهًا وَاحِدًا وَ نَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُوْنَ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, the One God, and we are submitting to Him

Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَ لَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ، مُخْلِصِيْنَ لَهُ الدِّيْنَ، وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُوْنَ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, and we worship none but Him, dedicating our faith purely to Him, even if the polytheists detest it

Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، رَبُّنَا وَ رَبُّ آبَائِنَا الْاَوَّلِيْنَ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, our Lord and the Lord of our forefathers

Arabic text: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ وَحْدَهُ وَحْدَهُ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَأَعَزَّ جُنْدَهُ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, Alone, Alone, Alone, He fulfilled His promise, supported His servant, and strengthened His soldiers

Arabic text: وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ، فَلَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ
Translation: And He alone defeated the confederates, to Him belongs the dominion, and to Him belongs all praise
He gives life and causes death, and causes death and gives life

Arabic text: وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوْتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
Translation: And He is Ever-Living and never dies, in His Hand is all good, and He has power over all things
